component.name: Lynvest
component.summary: Fast, 100% offline personal finance & investment tracker

description.p: Lynvest is a modern, privacy-first personal finance and wealth management application built for Linux. Track bank accounts, physical cash, budgets, upcoming bills, and investment portfolios (stocks, crypto, mutual funds) completely offline with zero telemetry.

ul.li: 100% Offline & Private — No bank account linking, no cloud storage, and no tracking
Double-entry style atomic ledger accounting ensuring tamper-proof balance integrity
Multi-currency conversion with customizable number formatting (Millions vs Lakhs/Crores)
Investment portfolio tracker with cost-basis calculations and manual price history logs
Active budget velocity pace warnings and category limits
Upcoming bill reminders with due date countdowns
6-digit bcrypt PIN security and automated daily database snapshots

description.p: Initial release of Lynvest for Linux desktop.
